title: Employ staff under the Funeral Industry Award 2020
what: Pay and employ staff at no less than the terms of the Funeral Industry Award 2020.

sources.title: Funeral Industry Award 2020
sources.quote: 4.1 This industry award covers employers throughout Australia in the funeral industry and their employees in the classifications listed in clause 12 — Classifications to the exclusion of any other modern award.

reach.condition: funeral services and the removal of remains; cemeteries have their own award (cl 4.2, 4.3)
reach.note: National system employers that are companies, in every state.

sources.title: Funeral Industry Award 2020
sources.quote: 4.2 Funeral industry means the provision of funeral services, coffin manufacturing, the removal of deceased human remains and any ancillary services.

sources.title: Which system of employment laws applies
sources.publisher: Government of Western Australia (Private Sector Labour Relations)
sources.quote: The state system covers: Private sector businesses and their employees that operate as: Sole traders. Partnerships, where none of the partners in the business is a constitutional corporation (trading or financial corporation).

assessment.summary: The Funeral Industry Award sets the industry's classifications, minimum pay, allowances and penalty rates on top of the National Employment Standards.

marks.reason: Classifications, allowances, penalty rates and their record-keeping add to the cost and complexity of employing in the industry.

assessment.confidence_note: Economic reasoning and desk research only; no evaluation of this requirement found. Drafted 12 Nov 2026 from the award's coverage clause, not yet checked.
